title: tests/kernel/test_skcipher.c: in-kernel tests for cbc/ctr/xts(aes)
description: Kernel module that tests the three AES skcipher registrations. For each algorithm (cbc(aes), ctr(aes), xts(aes)): allocate via crypto_alloc_skcipher() using the .cra_name (not the driver name); verify via /proc/crypto that wolfkm is the selected driver (not the built-in); run 3+ NIST CAVP encrypt vectors (compare output byte-for-byte against tests/vectors/aes_cbc.h etc.); run 3+ decrypt vectors; run empty-input and max-block-size edge cases. Print 'wolfkm_test: cbc(aes) vector N: PASS/FAIL' to dmesg for each check.
design: Use crypto_skcipher_encrypt/decrypt with a skcipher_request. Allocate skcipher_request with skcipher_request_alloc. Build scatterlist from a kmalloc'd buffer for testing (single-entry SGL is fine for tests). Check crypto_skcipher_driver_name() == 'wolfkm-cbc-aes' after alloc. Free everything on module_exit. See CLAUDE.md §Test Design Constraint — vectors from tests/vectors/aes_cbc.h only.
acceptance_criteria: All PASS lines in dmesg, zero FAIL lines. /proc/crypto shows wolfkm driver for all three algorithms during test. Module loads and unloads without memory leaks.
